title: Minimum Building Deductible on a Renewed Policy's Proof of Loss — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Deductible rule for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): the building deductible a building proof of loss subtracts once the policy's premium account shows a renewal risk premium charge is held to the federal minimum for the building limit.

**Rule.** The building deductible a building proof of loss subtracts is settled as follows: when the building limit is above the deductible threshold, the building deductible shown on the policy is below the higher minimum building deductible and the premium account shows a renewal risk premium charge, it is that higher minimum; when the building limit is at or below the deductible threshold, the building deductible shown on the policy is below the lower minimum building deductible and the premium account shows a renewal risk premium charge, it is that lower minimum; otherwise it is the building deductible shown on the policy.

The figures on every tier: the deductible threshold is a building limit of 100000; the lower minimum building deductible is 1000; the higher minimum building deductible is 1250.

## Condition table

| Building limit | Deductible shown on the policy | Renewal risk premium charge on the premium account | Deductible subtracted |
|---|---|---|---|
| above 100000 | below 1250 | yes | 1250 |
| above 100000 | below 1250 | no | the deductible shown on the policy |
| above 100000 | 1250 or more | either | the deductible shown on the policy |
| 100000 or less | below 1000 | yes | 1000 |
| 100000 or less | below 1000 | no | the deductible shown on the policy |
| 100000 or less | 1000 or more | either | the deductible shown on the policy |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical policies, each with a renewal risk premium charge)

- Building limit 100,000 exactly, deductible shown 500: the limit is at the threshold, so the lower minimum of 1000 is subtracted.
- Building limit 100,100, deductible shown 1,000: above the threshold and below 1250, so 1250 is subtracted.
- Building limit 250,000, deductible shown 1,250: not below the higher minimum, so 1,250 as shown is subtracted.
